name: Crater / Red paper
look: Red paper with grain, a throat glowing from red through orange to yolk at the bottom of a well, a rim of hanging hair loops, scrawled stick figures falling into it; plate B is the same frame as a stepped heat map

axes.base: dense colour fill: flat crater red with paper grain
axes.line: scrawl: a thin trembling line in two or three passes a hair apart (stickFigure, springLimb); inkPath with pressure for the wordmark
axes.tone: the throat: a radial gradient down the crater ramp, red to orange to yolk at the bottom of the well
axes.planB: heat map: the same frame in stepped bands of the crater ramp, isotherms in scrawl, a banded scale
axes.motion: on twos (figures, the pulse) with the line and the grain boiling at 12 fps
axes.carrier: clean: paper grain only (post 0.8 on plate A)
axes.accent: yolk: the throat's core, at the bottom of the frame, nowhere else
axes.font: hand-scratched: strokeText in the hand style, in scratch on red
axes.match: silhouette: the hero figure keeps its outline and place across the cut
axes.overlays: none on plate A; the banded scale on plate B
